items.label: MA-AG civil: Ocwen Loan Servicing LLC
items.detail: Consent judgment in Suffolk Superior Court settling a 2017 AG suit over mortgage servicing violations (unnecessary force-placed flood insurance, inflated fees); date is the announcement date. The $2 million is restitution including cash refunds and account credits, plus treble damages on some escrow failures and loan modification outreach. Cash-only rule applied 2026-10-11: amount changed from 2,000,000 to 0; the part not counted is listed in data/manual/excluded-amounts.csv as xa-016.

excluded_amounts.reason: Release: "Ocwen will pay $2 million in restitution including direct cash refunds and account credits." The split is not stated, so the row counts $0.
excluded_amounts.category_label: Split not stated by the source (cash from relief, or between payers)
